groups.title: WebAssembly Fundamentals
groups.question: Explain what WebAssembly is and why it is useful for server-side and edge code.

followUps.WASM Binary Format and Memory Model: How does linear memory work in WASM, and what can go wrong when you pass data between JavaScript and a module?
followUps.WASM Component Model and WASI: What problem do WASI and the Component Model try to solve, and how mature is their support at the edge today?

groups.title: Rust to WASM Toolchain
groups.question: Walk through how you turn Rust code into something a Worker can call.

followUps.Compiling Rust with wasm-pack: What does wasm-pack do for you that you would otherwise have to do by hand?
followUps.wasm-bindgen for JS Interop: Why do you need wasm-bindgen to pass a string from JavaScript into a Rust function?

groups.title: AssemblyScript
groups.question: Explain how you decide whether rewriting a hot path in WASM is worth it.

followUps.AssemblyScript for TypeScript Developers: Why might AssemblyScript suit a TypeScript team better than Rust, and what limits does it have?
followUps.WASM Performance Benchmarking: Which workloads usually get faster in WASM, and how would you benchmark fairly before committing to a rewrite?

groups.title: WASM in Production
groups.question: Explain what you need to think about when running WASM modules in production Workers.

followUps.WASM Module Instantiation and Caching: Why should you set up a WASM module once per isolate instead of on every request?
followUps.Secure WASM Sandboxing: Where is the trust boundary between a WASM module and the Worker that hosts it?
